Class AssistedFactoryMocker<T,U>

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.testing.AssistedFactoryMocker<T,U>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of the class that is instantiated by the factory.
U - The type of the factory that instantiates the target class.
public class AssistedFactoryMocker<T,U> extends Object
Represents a class that can be used to create mocked objects for an AssistedFactory.

Any dependencies that cannot be mocked will default to null. These can later be manually updated using injectParameter(Class, String, Object) if needed.

Example usage: 

// The class with the AssistedInject constructor that we want to create a factory for.
public class MyObject {
    @AssistedInject
    MyObject(MyDependency myDependency,
             @Assisted String someString) {
        ...
    }
}

// The interface that represents the factory.
@AssistedFactory
public interface MyObjectFactory {
   MyObject create(String someString);
}

// Create a new factory using an existing instance of MyDependency.
public MyObjectFactory createMyObjectFactory(MyDependency existingMyDependency) {
    final var mocker = new AssistedFactoryMocker<>(MyObject.class, MyObjectFactory.class);
    mocker.setMock(MyDependency.class, existingMyDependency);
    return mocker.getFactory();
}

public MyObject createMyObject(MyObjectFactory factory, String someString) {
    return factory.create(someString);
}

  • Method Details

    • injectMocksFromTestClass

      public static <T,U> AssistedFactoryMocker<T,U> injectMocksFromTestClass(Class<U> factoryClass, Object testInstance) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Creates a new AssistedFactoryMocker instance using the mocked objects from the provided test class.

      This method is a shortcut for injectMocksFromTestClass(Class, Class, Object).

      Specifically, it will look for fields in the test class that are annotated with Mock and inject them into the factory method if any of the parameters in the factory method match the type of the field.

      Type Parameters:
      T - The type of the class that is instantiated by the factory.
      U - The type of the factory that instantiates the target class.
      Parameters:
      factoryClass - The factory class that instantiates the target class.
      testInstance - The instance of a test class that contains the mocked objects.
      Returns:
      A new AssistedFactoryMocker instance.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the factory method or the target constructor could not be found.

    • injectParameters

      public AssistedFactoryMocker<T,U> injectParameters(Object... params)
      Injects the parameters in the factory method.

      Note that all primitive types are automatically boxed and will not match any primitive types in the constructor.

      Because no type is provided for the parameters, the type of the parameter is inferred from the value and will be compared against the type of the parameter in the constructor using Class.isAssignableFrom(Class) instead of requiring an exact match.

      If it is required for the type to be exact, use injectParameter(Class, Object) instead.

      Additionally, because this method does not know the name of the parameters, it will not match any named parameters in the constructor. To match named parameters, use injectParameter(Class, String, Object).

      Parameters:
      params - The parameters to provide to the factory method.
      Returns:
      The current AssistedFactoryMocker instance.
